QuestInfo.name: [6th Day of Memories] Memories of Cleaning
QuestInfo.0: #p9010010# has something to discuss with you.
QuestInfo.1: Collect 50 #t3994391# to keep Maple World clean.
QuestInfo.2: Maple World is now a cleaner place, thanks to you!

0.0: Everyone sure is happy these days, yeah? Now that we've had our fun, though, it's time for some cleaning up.

yes.0: You understand that if we want to enjoy a clean Maple World, we have to work for it. I've heard that there are lots of #t3994391# that people have been throwing away. Well, monsters have gotten ahold of the #t3994391#, and are making a mess of Maple World with them. Get back 50 #t3994391# from normal monsters, would you? Oh, but you won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you.

no.0: So, what you're saying is that you DON'T care about keeping Maple World clean...

default.0: Geez, I would expect you to know if you had 50 #t3994391# or not...
